name: Eldoria
source:
In a world where Earth and Eldoria are mysteriously connected, Akuma, a half-demon hiding among humans, is thrust into a conflict far greater than himself. As war rages between kingdoms and dark forces rise, he must navigate love, power, and destiny while keeping his true nature a secret. His journey will lead him to powerful allies, dangerous enemies, and choices that will shape the fate of both worlds.

Step into the role of Akuma — a half-demon torn between two worlds — and begin your journey into a realm of war, desire, destiny and love.

[From Itch.io]
